summary: Tank and Trinity prepare to unplug Morpheus's body, mourning him as a father and leader. Neo stops them, claiming the Oracle predicted this moment would require a choice. He declares he is not the One and that Morpheus is the one who matters. Despite Tank's objection that it is suicide, Neo resolves to go back into the Matrix to save Morpheus because he believes he can. Trinity, refusing to accept that Neo is just another guy, insists on joining him, asserting her authority and belief that Morpheus means more to her than to Neo.

what_changes.before: Believed he was the One based on Morpheus's faith and the Oracle's words.
what_changes.after: Accepts he is not the One, stating 'I'm just another guy.'

what_changes.before: Paralyzed by the finality of Morpheus's death.
what_changes.after: Resolves to go back into the Matrix to save Morpheus.
what_changes.evidence: NEO I'm going in. ... NEO I believe I can [...].

what_changes.before: Mourning Morpheus and unable to bear watching, closing her eyes in tears.
what_changes.after: Decides to accompany Neo into the Matrix, asserting her belief and authority.
what_changes.evidence: TRINITY I'm coming with you. ... TRINITY Tank, load us up.

event_hint.one_line: The crew mourns Morpheus before Neo and Trinity decide to re-enter the Matrix to save him.
